name: rotem-mods
description: Claude Code mods by Rotem: context usage, session topics, and an orchestrator mode

plugins.name: context-usage
plugins.description: Shows how full the session's context window is, in a band above the prompt

plugins.name: session-topics
plugins.description: Shows the session's topics and a per-session color above the prompt, so side-by-side sessions are easy to tell apart

plugins.name: orchestrator
plugins.description: Turns a session into an orchestrator that delegates work to Haiku 5.5 and Sonnet 5.5 subagents, keeps its own context small, and lists the running and past agents in an expandable band whose rows open a tabbed agent inspector: the outcome at a glance, the whole brief in cards, every step with its input and output, and a token view of how the agent's context grew, with charts on desktop (/orchestrator on|off|status)
